patterns.note: Full-bleed content sections utilize distinct background colors (dark blue, light green, white) to visually segment the page, creating strong vertical rhythm.
Consistent use of responsive 3-column and 4-column grids for displaying product features, vehicle models, and owner benefits.

The main navigation bar transitions from a transparent overlay on the hero to a solid white background with a subtle shadow and adjusted branding elements (like the 'Ask HeyHyundai' button) as the user scrolls past the hero section.
The hero image/video background scrolls at a slightly slower rate than the foreground content, creating a subtle parallax effect.
Dedicated sections for 'Our Vehicles' (using a horizontal carousel), 'Showroom Live' (featuring a video player), and 'Owner Benefits' each have a distinct visual treatment and content focus.

A deep brand blue (#002c5e) is used extensively for background sections and primary text, providing a sophisticated and authoritative feel, often contrasted with bright white text and light accent colors.

technique_notes: The main navigation bar transitions from a transparent overlay on the hero to a solid, sticky bar with a subtle shadow and adjusted branding elements (like the 'Ask HeyHyundai' button) as the user scrolls past the hero section, achieved with CSS transitions.
Full-width content sections utilize distinct background colors to visually separate content blocks, creating a clear vertical rhythm and aiding content scannability.
Product and feature displays are organized into responsive grid layouts (3-4 columns) with images, concise text, and call-to-action links, adapting to different screen sizes.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (Hyundai-Sans Head) provide strong visual hierarchy, often 2-3x the size of the body text (Roboto), with smaller uppercase labels for navigation and sub-elements.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle; most elements have sharp corners, but some buttons and input fields have a very slight rounding.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced; sections are clearly separated with ample vertical padding, while content within grids is moderately dense. The hero section is airy.

standout: The site effectively uses distinct, full-bleed background colors for different content sections, creating strong visual segmentation and a clear flow down the page. This, combined with the dynamic hero video/image and the transforming sticky navigation, gives it a premium, interactive feel that goes beyond a standard marketing template.
